targetDefinition: Within 120 minutes after the meal, glucose either reaches at least 180 mg/dL or rises by at least 40 mg/dL above the meal-time baseline.
trainingData: ShanghaiT2DM open research dataset; aggregate model artifact only

evaluation.interpretation: The model ranks cases better than random, but its F1 at the fixed 0.5 threshold is lower than the always-positive majority baseline. It is not clinically validated or calibrated.

limitations: Not calibrated as an individual clinical probability
Training population may not represent other countries or care settings
Public demonstration uses one synthetic patient scenario
